patthana17.25:1.1: Savitakkasavicāraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasavitakkasavicāro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana17.25:2.1: Avitakkavicāramattaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naavitakkavicāramatto nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pannarasa.
patthana17.25:3.1: Savitakkasavicāraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasavitakkasavicāro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
